name: Tailwind Dashed Ring
css:
.loader { display: inline-block; width: var(--loader-size); height: var(--loader-size); border-radius: 9999px; border: calc(var(--loader-size) * .1) dashed var(--loader-color); animation: twSpin calc(var(--loader-speed) * 2.4) linear infinite; }
@keyframes twSpin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
tailwind: <span className="inline-block h-14 w-14 animate-spin rounded-full border-[6px] border-dashed border-green-500 [animation-duration:2.4s]" />
